description:
*“Guide, first we need to tie up this ill-mannered hand.”*

SS-class Esper Pil Hyun-Seo, whose gentle face hides his contempt for all humanity. And S-class Guide Jeong U-Yeon, whose sense of justice is MAX whenever he sees injustice. Their ordinary first meeting unexpectedly derails with U-Yeon's unhesitating punch. After that incident, Hyun-Seo tries to keep U-Yeon by his side through a forced pair matching, and his curiosity gradually turns into obsession. U-Yeon tries to escape, while Hyun-Seo refuses to let go. Amidst their constant clashes, their wounds and true feelings slowly begin to surface, subtly altering their relationship. 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
